summary: Zeta Network Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing the closing of a private placement of 3,412,970 units at $2.93 per unit, each consisting of one ordinary share and one warrant exercisable at $4.40, for gross proceeds of $10,000,002.10, paid in the form of approximately 156.6533 Solv-BTC at an exchange rate of $63,835.08 per Solv-BTC. The securities were issued to certain investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S, unregistered. The filing is a routine disclosure of a completed securities offering, not a special situation.
